feed.title: The Elon Gazette
feed.subtitle: Weekday briefing on what Elon Musk is saying and doing
feed.rights: The Elon Gazette is compiled from public posts on X and published reporting. Quotes are reproduced verbatim unless marked as translated or paraphrased.

entry.title: Tuesday, October 27, 2026: Six million miles, and "2 or 3 years"
entry.summary:
Tesla's updated safety page now puts cars driven with FSD (Supervised) at 6,006,200 miles per major collision in North America over the latest 12 months, against 2,031,221 miles for Teslas driven manually with active safety features and a U.S. average of 660,164. Tesla counts a collision against FSD if the system was active within five seconds of impact. At 11:55 p.m. EDT on Monday, Elon Musk replied with a "100" emoji to a post by Pierre Ferragu that it is "10x safer to not-drive FSD than to drive a non-Tesla. What are you waiting for, Europe?" Earlier in the day Musk had welcomed approval of the software in Latvia.

On the SpaceX side, Verizon's chief executive told analysts on Monday that a Starlink Mobile network able to compete in U.S. cities would take years and hundreds of billions of dollars, Yahoo Finance reported. Musk's reply at 1:40 p.m. EDT: "Will take 2 or 3 years." The same day, Starlink's phone service went live across Brazil.

entry.title: Monday, October 26, 2026: Starlink's terms, and a $40 billion lease
entry.summary:
Elon Musk spent the weekend defending SpaceX's decision to restrict how Ukraine's military uses Starlink. "Ukraine military violated Starlink terms of service and used it for offensive drone strikes to kill people. That loophole was closed last week," he posted at 2:38 p.m. EDT on Saturday, adding that "SpaceX has done more to defend Ukraine than any private company on Earth BY FAR." A Ukrainian adviser disputed the account on Sunday, and Ukraine's Defense Ministry said Saturday that Starlink speeds had been restored on fast-moving equipment, CNBC reported.

On Monday, SpaceX disclosed a binding commitment for a roughly $40 billion lease to finance graphics processing units (GPUs), the chips that train and run artificial intelligence (AI) systems. The company's 8-K filing names an Apollo-managed entity as the lessor. Musk had previewed it Sunday and used it to argue that lenders are now rationing money for companies without revenue beyond AI data centers.

entry.title: Friday, October 23, 2026: Two committees, two down days
entry.summary:
Both of Elon Musk's public companies now describe the review of a possible combination in their quarterly reports. "The Tesla board of directors has formed a special committee (the 'Special Committee') comprising disinterested directors to explore deepening Tesla's relationship with SpaceX, which could be through certain arrangements including without limitation a business combination," Tesla's 10-Q says. SpaceX's 10-Q, filed at 4:03 p.m. EDT Thursday, says its board "has formed a special committee to evaluate a potential combination between SpaceX and Tesla, Inc.," and that "No determination by our special committee has been made."

Both stocks fell on Thursday. Tesla lost 3.08% to $374.58 after cutting its 2026 capital spending forecast to about $20 billion, Reuters reported, and SpaceX dropped 9.14% to $144.75 as the first tranche of locked-up shares became eligible for sale, according to The Motley Fool and the prospectus. A combination could create a company worth about $3.5 trillion, Reuters said.

entry.title: Thursday, October 22, 2026: "Headed for a lot of fun and significant growth"
entry.summary:
Opening Tesla's third-quarter webcast on Wednesday, Elon Musk said demand for its cars "is exceeding our production by a significant margin," driven above all by Full Self-Driving (FSD), and that "after many years of grind and things being fairly flat, I think we are now headed for a lot of fun and significant growth," according to a transcript. He also asked investors to be patient on the Optimus robot: "I do want to temper expectations that we still have a lot to get through."

Tesla earned an adjusted 48 cents a share on $28.05 billion in revenue, ahead of the 43 cents and $27.9 billion analysts polled by LSEG expected, CNBC reported. The shares, up 3.4% in Wednesday's session, were down about 4% in premarket trading on Thursday, CNBC noted.

entry.title: Wednesday, October 21, 2026: "A lot of merit to combining the companies"
entry.summary:
On SpaceX's third-quarter webcast Tuesday, Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have each formed special committees of independent directors to explore a merger. "Because I'm a conflicted party, I can't actually be in the discussions of the special committees," he said, The Guardian reported. "I think some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla merger is a certainty and I think that would be overstating it." No terms have been agreed.

The call followed results that beat forecasts: revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161%, and net income of $4.4 billion (SpaceX). Tesla reports its own quarter after Wednesday's close, with a webcast at 5:30 p.m. EDT.

entry.title: Tuesday, October 20, 2026: "Directly to the people is the way"
entry.summary:
A day after pledging one SpaceX share to every American child, Elon Musk spent Monday defending the idea and thanking the people behind the delivery mechanism. President Trump announced that the shares will go through Trump Accounts, the tax-advantaged accounts for children, The Verge reported; 72 million shares would be worth about $10.5 billion at Friday's price.

SpaceX reports quarterly results after Tuesday's close and Tesla on Wednesday. In between, Musk announced changes to how X ranks posts, kept promoting the Grok Bot agent, and Tesla's board urged shareholders to keep him on its board, calling him "the architect of our transformation."

entry.title: Monday, October 19, 2026: "I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America"
entry.summary:
Elon Musk answered Anthropic's new public benefit fund with a pledge of his own before dawn Monday: one SpaceX share for every American child next year, "the first of many." At Friday's close that is about $10.5 billion, CNBC calculated. Hours later Tesla filed a proxy asking shareholders to re-elect him to its board on December 3.

SpaceX reports quarterly results Tuesday and Tesla on Wednesday. Over the weekend Musk traded a Monty Python insult with AI scientist Yann LeCun over the flying Roadster, urged Texans to vote as early voting opened in the Senate race he is funding, and watched Washington and Kyiv argue over who capped Ukraine's Starshield service.

entry.title: Friday, October 16, 2026: "Turns out the future does have flying cars"
entry.summary:
Elon Musk's Tesla showed a Roadster on Thursday night that clung upside down to a ramp, flipped through the air on SpaceX thrusters and jumped a row of Tesla vehicles at a SpaceX site in McGregor, Texas. He said production starts in 2028. Earlier, a Falcon 9 had launched a classified Space Force payload from California.

Musk said the Star Mind computer SpaceX is building with Nvidia "will reach volume production next year." A federal filing showed his $158 million made him the main donor behind a record quarter for the Republicans' Senate super PAC. Ukraine said its Starlink service is back to full strength. SpaceXAI testifies to the New York City Council at 10 a.m. EDT today.

entry.title: Thursday, October 15, 2026: Starshield slowdown, "Time for Zelensky to go," and the Roadster tonight
entry.summary:
Ukraine said SpaceX restricted military Starshield terminals on moving vehicles overnight into Wednesday. Elon Musk replied that Starshield limits are "decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," clashed again with Poland's foreign minister and, late Wednesday, posted that it was "Time for Zelensky to go."

Tonight at 8:55 p.m. EDT, Tesla streams its new Roadster reveal, which Musk calls "a candidate for greatest product demo of all time." His roughly $366 million in midterm giving is due in a federal filing today, according to The Guardian. On X he pushed Grok Bot and the new Grok Voice 3.0, and said SpaceX will make users whole if Grok Bot errs with a purchase.

entry.title: Wednesday, October 14, 2026: A start time for the Roadster, a federal review of Starbase, and SpaceXAI heads to City Hall
entry.summary:
Tesla says its Roadster demonstration will stream live on Thursday at 8:55 p.m. EDT, and Elon Musk added, "Timing is everything." The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) began a full environmental review of SpaceX's plan for up to 456 Starship launches a year from Starbase, Texas, and SpaceX shares fell 4.21% on Tuesday. SpaceXAI agreed to testify before the New York City Council on Friday after a subpoena fight.

Musk's roughly $366 million in midterm giving is due to appear in a federal filing on Thursday, The Guardian reported. On X, he promoted Grok Bot through much of Tuesday, told chief executives that posting directly on X beats a press release, and said that, despite leading a podcast's beer count, he hardly ever drinks.

entry.title: Tuesday, October 13, 2026: $276 million for the midterms, a new name for FSD in Europe, and one subscription for Grok, Cursor and X
entry.summary:
Elon Musk has given more than $276 million to Republican groups since July, making him the biggest known donor of the 2026 midterm elections, according to figures his representatives gave The New York Times and America PAC confirmed on Monday. That brings his known federal giving this cycle to about $366 million, more than the roughly $290 million he spent in 2024, after he said in May 2025 he would spend "a lot less."

At Tesla, Full Self-Driving (Supervised) is now "Tesla Assisted Driving" in Europe, a name change Germany's transport minister had demanded, and federal regulators opened a file on claims that robotaxis sped through school zones. SpaceX's AI arm folded Grok, Cursor and X Premium into one plan, The X Subscription, and Musk spent much of Monday night reposting praise for Grok Bot. SpaceX launched twice in ten hours, sending Starlink satellites up from California and a cargo Dragon toward the space station from Florida.

entry.title: Monday, October 12, 2026: "Prime Minister Ambani," a ship catch on the calendar, and a call to replace Zelensky
entry.summary:
Since Friday morning, Elon Musk spent much of his time on X in a running fight with Mukesh Ambani over Starlink's stalled start in India. He addressed the Reliance chairman as "Prime Minister Ambani" on Friday, shared old reports on Reliance's political ties on Saturday and, by Sunday, was calling Ambani's online defenders an "army of Internet shills." India's communications minister answered that the country "does not allow monopoly in any sector."

On Saturday Musk joined the fan-run X Takeover at Giga Texas by video. He said the next Starship flight, "hopefully" four to six weeks away, will try to catch the ship with the launch tower, and he described Tesla's chipmaking plans. The same day he backed President Donald Trump's call for Ukraine to get a new president ("Zelensky has gone too far"), called electricity production "the best metric for the true strength of any large-scale economy," and said Grok Bot can now shop online. Tesla's Robotaxi account said more than 300 Cybercabs are now serving Austin.

entry.title: Friday, October 9, 2026: A spectrum "earthquake," a medal for a "modern-day Edison," and a bot for hire
entry.summary:
Since late Thursday morning EDT, Elon Musk posted about 50 times, and two events set the tone. At the White House "Science: A New Golden Age" summit, President Donald Trump hung the National Medal of Science on him, calling him "an industrial titan, a brilliant engineer, and one of the greatest technology founders ever to live." A few hours later SpaceX announced a deal to buy a nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio from Grain Management. Musk called it "the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle" for complete phone coverage in America, and by Friday morning U.S. and European telecom stocks were sliding.

Between those stories, Musk kept pitching Grok Bot as cheap, capable labor ("like hiring a super smart, hard-working person for peanuts"). He said bots will manage Grokipedia and pointed to a legal benchmark where Grok 4.7 ranked first. He also joked that AI labs should test on Delta flights, backed Anthropic's new rule against abusing Claude, reacted to three OpenAI safety researchers going public about their firings, and agreed with a fan that Tesla's new European name for its driver-assist software undersells it.

entry.title: Thursday, October 8, 2026: Starlink's India fight, a Grok Bot shopping clerk, and a White House medal
entry.summary:
In the day and a half since Wednesday morning EDT, Elon Musk posted about 93 times. The through-line was Starlink: he accused Indian "oligarchs" of blocking a license after five years of compliance, asked whether Mukesh Ambani is "the real boss of India," celebrated Starlink Mobile in Bangladesh, cheered Koninklijke Luchtvaart Maatschappij (KLM) picking Starlink for free intercontinental Wi-Fi, and welcomed Crew-12's Dragon splashdown off Los Angeles. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) clearance for 15,000 next-generation direct-to-phone satellites sat under it all.

On the product side, Grok Bot gained a Shopify connector, a promise that simple requests will ride a fast Grok 4.8, and an open router that can call Claude Opus 5.5 and other models. This afternoon, President Donald Trump is set to award Musk the National Medal of Science at the White House "Science: A New Golden Age" summit alongside Sergey Brin, Jensen Huang, and Lisa Su.
